responsibility: Provides the main 64-bit and bi-arch Linux configuration layer for the rs6000 backend. It controls 32/64-bit defaults, ELFv1/ELFv2- and TOC-related behavior, assembler/link/startfile specs, code-model and split-stack support, target type sizes, TOC section handling, EH encodings, profiling and SSP conventions, and Linux-specific feature hooks, making it the central OS/ABI header for PowerPC64 Linux and mixed 32/64 multilib configurations.
same_name_distinction: This is the Linux64 configuration header, not the option table: it defines the PowerPC64 Linux bi-arch/ABI environment, specs, TOC and type macros, and OS capability policy, while linux64.opt only declares the Linux64-specific switches and variables those policies use.
